comparison.objective: Load and center a wafer on a spin-coater chuck using tweezers and an aligner while holding the lid.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool changes, edge-only wafer pinching, aligner docking/extraction, and sustained bimanual lid support; not fastener unlocking or damping adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Wafer centered on the 24 mm chuck within 0.5 mm, aligner removed, lid closed, and no gripper/top-surface contact.
comparison.reason: Tests contamination-safe precision handling and centering, a different compound ability from impact-response tuning and lock retention.
